title: The Immutable Past: Formalizing State Mutability and Conflict Resolution in Mutable RAG
abstract: arXiv:2609.16073v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) serves as the primary memory architecture for long-horizon autonomous agents. However, treating shared memory as an append-only stream introduces \textit{Semantic Shadowing}, a critical failure mode where conflicting historical observations accumulate and statistically dominate valid recent updates. In dynamic environments, this results in severe state divergence as agents retrieve and act upon obsolete facts. This paper formalizes the mechanics of State Mutability to prove that standard dense retrieval suffers from Asymptotic Recall Decay. Furthermore, we formally demonstrate a Majority Vote Trap, revealing that increasing the retrieval context window paradoxically degrades generation accuracy by diluting the attention mechanism under conditions of semantic equivalence. To resolve this, we introduce GC-Mem (Garbage Collection for Memory), a strict inference-time consistency protocol. Unlike heurist

translated_title: 不可变的过去：可变RAG中状态可变性与冲突解决的形式化
translated_abstract: 检索增强生成（RAG）是长时程自主智能体的主要记忆架构。然而，将共享记忆视为仅追加（append-only）的数据流会引入“语义遮蔽”这一关键失效模式，即相互冲突的历史观测不断累积，并在统计上压倒有效的最新更新。在动态环境中，当智能体检索并基于过时事实采取行动时，会导致严重的状态偏离。本文对状态可变性机制进行了形式化，证明标准稠密检索会遭受“渐近召回衰减”。此外，我们正式证明了“多数投票陷阱”的存在，揭示出一个悖论：在语义等价条件下，增大检索上下文窗口会因稀释注意力机制反而降低生成准确率。为解决这一问题，我们提出了GC-Mem（记忆垃圾回收，Garbage Collection for Memory），一种严格的推理时一致性协议。与启发式方法不同……（原文摘要至此截断）
tldr: 该论文形式化揭示了可变RAG中历史冲突观测累积导致的“语义遮蔽”、稠密检索的“渐近召回衰减”以及上下文窗口扩大反而降低准确率的“多数投票陷阱”，并据此提出GC-Mem——一种推理时记忆垃圾回收一致性协议，以解决智能体记忆的状态偏离问题。
